public_rationale: There was clearly a large backlash. Sensor Tower measured a 295% one-day jump in ChatGPT uninstalls against a 9% norm (e3). But the only figures in the millions come from the QuitGPT campaign itself: 1.5 million sign-ups reported on March 4 (e2) and a claimed 2.5 million by March 5 (e1). The 2.5 million counts social media shares along with cancellations, and nobody has verified it. No independent count or poll measured anger at OpenAI or Altman at this scale. The claim is plausible, but the evidence does not settle whether 'millions, literally' were angry.
limitations: Anger is hard to measure directly. Proxies may undercount or overcount it.
Polls on AI and the military were not specific to OpenAI and could not all be read.
